articles.title: Three Sui mainnet halts in 48 hours traced to an upgrade bug by developers
articles.snippet: The Sui Foundation's post-mortem published Sunday traces all three outages to interactions between a new address-balance feature shipped in the v1.72 release and the network's existing gas and consensus logic.

articles.title: US, UK central bankers offer contrary views on stablecoins
articles.snippet: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told a conference on Sunday that stablecoins expand the reach of US policy while the Bank of England’s Megan Greene expects their popularity will soon fade.
